title: [SOA] Uptake Agent Task Message Failed status for outbound replies
summary: Sales Order Agent now marks outbound replies as Failed when they exhaust their retry budget, leveraging a new terminal Failed status from the Agent Runtime instead of application-side state. This prevents failed messages from being re-processed on subsequent agent runs.
key_points: New Failed status transition for output messages in Agent Runtime, replacing the workaround that kept failed replies in Reviewed state
Added SetStatusToFailed() and SetStatusToReviewed() methods to Agent Message codeunits for managing terminal transitions
Failed replies are excluded from send processing and no longer generate recurring telemetry
Retry sending action on SOA Email Message page now performs Failed -> Reviewed transition instead of deleting private table rows
Terminal failure check runs before send loop to avoid transaction handling issues from trapped errors after COMMIT
